newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia issues 19.38 trln rbls in Jan-Nov - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Russia issues 19.38 trln rbls in Jan-Nov - Interfax.

text.p: Russia issued 19.38 trillion roubles in cash in January-November 1996, well below the 35.35 trillion for the same period of 1995, Interfax news agency quoted State Statistics commitee officials as saying on Tuesday.

The officials said in November alone the cash issue was 1.69 trillion. They said before November the central bank had been withdrawing cash from circulation for four months. It withdrew a total of 7.37 trillion roubles.
The biggest monthly cash issue of 10.48 trillion roubles was registered in June, while the biggest withdrawal of 4.93 trillion took place in September, the officials said.
